final_message:
I fixed `int_to_roman` in `src/roman.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

The bug was that the value table had no subtractive pairs. Inputs like 4, 9, 40, 90, 400 and 900 came out as "IIII", "VIIII" and so on instead of "IV", "IX", "XL", "XC", "CD" and "CM". I added those six pairs to the table, in descending order, so the existing greedy loop now handles them.

I left `roman_to_int` alone. It already handles subtractive forms.
